name: ftc-biobuzz-sim

scripts.cad: .venv-cad/bin/python -I cadtools/step2glb.py research/cad/3200-2627-0003.step assets/biobuzz/biobuzz-starterbot.glb 0.6 0.9 && node cadtools/make-biobuzz-assembly.mjs assets/biobuzz/biobuzz-starterbot.glb robots/biobuzz-assembly.json /assets/biobuzz/biobuzz-starterbot.glb assets/biobuzz/part-volumes.json && node cadtools/make-collision.mjs assets/biobuzz/biobuzz-starterbot.glb robots/biobuzz-assembly.json assets/biobuzz/collision.json
scripts.cad:mass: .venv-cad/bin/python -I cadtools/step_volumes.py research/cad/3200-2627-0003.step assets/biobuzz/part-volumes.json && node cadtools/estimate-mass.mjs assets/biobuzz/part-volumes.json robots/biobuzz-starterbot.json
scripts.cad:field: .venv-cad/bin/python -I cadtools/step2glb.py research/field/field-cad-step.step assets/field/biobuzz-field.glb 1.0 0.8 yup && .venv-cad/bin/python -I cadtools/step2glb.py research/field/field-cad-step.step assets/field/biobuzz-field-coarse.glb 4.0 1.4 yup && node cadtools/make-field.mjs assets/field/biobuzz-field-coarse.glb assets/field/field-collision.json
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run jre && electron-builder --mac --arm64

description: Local simulator for the goBILDA BIOBUZZ StarterBot that runs real FTC Java OpModes
author: FTC team
